# Community Matters Named Best Bank Website


Announced by Jack Henry on Oct. 5, 2026


“Our Community Matters site is where we tell the stories of the people and organizations we’ve been proud to support, so we wanted it to feel as personal as those stories are.”
— Tim Miano, digital marketing manager at Great Southern Bank


Jennifer Russell


Great Southern Bank’s Community Matters website has been named Best Bank Website in the 2026 WebAwards. It is the competition’s top honor in the banking category. Jack Henry, the bank’s longtime technology partner, built the site and nominated it for the award.


The Web Marketing Association has run the WebAwards for 18 years. Judges from around the world review websites in 86 industries, scoring them on design, innovation, content, interactivity, copywriting and ease of use.


Community Matters is where Great Southern shares stories about the people and organizations it supports in the communities it serves.


“Our Community Matters site is where we tell the stories of the people and organizations we’ve been proud to support, so we wanted it to feel as personal as those stories are,” said Tim Miano, digital marketing manager at Great Southern Bank. “Jack Henry understood that from the start and helped us build something that’s easy to explore and genuinely reflects who we are. We’re grateful for the partnership and honored by the recognition.”


[Explore Community Matters ->](https://community.greatsouthernbank.com/)
